description: Evaluation set for the Zidipay Policy RAG. 20 in-corpus + 4 out-of-corpus.

in_corpus.question: How many days of annual leave does a permanent employee accrue per year at Zidipay?
in_corpus.gold_answer: Permanent employees accrue 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year, at 2 days per month.

in_corpus.question: How many days of annual leave can be carried over into the next year and by when must they be used?
in_corpus.gold_answer: Up to 5 unused days may be carried into the next calendar year and must be used by 31 March.

in_corpus.question: How much maternity leave does Zidipay offer?
in_corpus.gold_answer: 90 calendar days of fully paid maternity leave, with up to an additional 30 days of unpaid leave on request.

in_corpus.question: What is the per-head limit for a client dinner?
in_corpus.gold_answer: KES 8,000 per head.

in_corpus.question: What is the domestic per-diem rate for business travel?
in_corpus.gold_answer: KES 6,500 per night for domestic travel within your home country.

in_corpus.question: How many days do I have to submit my expenses after incurring them?
in_corpus.gold_answer: Expenses must be submitted within 30 days of being incurred.

in_corpus.question: How many days per week are hybrid employees expected to be in the office?
in_corpus.gold_answer: At least 3 days per week, with Tuesday and Wednesday as mandatory anchor days.

in_corpus.question: Who is eligible for fully remote work at Zidipay?
in_corpus.gold_answer: Fully remote work is available case-by-case for roles at Level 4 and above, subject to Head of Department and Head of People approval.

in_corpus.question: How quickly must a suspected security incident be reported?
in_corpus.gold_answer: Within 60 minutes of discovery, by email to security@zidipay.example or via the 24/7 hotline.

in_corpus.question: What is the required second factor for MFA at Zidipay?
in_corpus.gold_answer: The YubiKey hardware token. SMS-based MFA is explicitly prohibited.

in_corpus.question: When is Mashujaa Day observed in Kenya in 2024?
in_corpus.gold_answer: Sunday, 20 October 2024.

in_corpus.question: What are Zidipay's core working hours?
in_corpus.gold_answer: Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00 local time, when all employees must be reachable.

in_corpus.question: What is the maximum daily transaction limit for a Tier 1 wallet?
in_corpus.gold_answer: KES 50,000 per day, with a maximum balance of KES 100,000.

in_corpus.question: What documents are required to upgrade to a Tier 2 wallet?
in_corpus.gold_answer: A government-issued ID plus proof of address (utility bill or bank statement no older than 3 months).

in_corpus.question: How far in advance must international travel be booked?
in_corpus.gold_answer: At least 14 calendar days in advance, through the company travel agent Maridadi Travel.

in_corpus.question: What is the standard probation period at Zidipay?
in_corpus.gold_answer: 3 months, extendable once by 1 month with a written reason.

in_corpus.question: When is access disabled for a departing employee?
in_corpus.gold_answer: At 17:00 local time on the last working day, regardless of how amicable the departure.

in_corpus.question: Within how many days must Zidipay respond to a data subject access request?
in_corpus.gold_answer: Within 30 calendar days, extendable by another 30 days for complex requests.

in_corpus.question: What is the de minimis threshold above which gifts must be disclosed at Zidipay?
in_corpus.gold_answer: Gifts of KES 5,000 or more (per item, per giver, per year) must be reported within 7 days.

in_corpus.question: What is the RTO for a Sev 1 incident?
in_corpus.gold_answer: 30 minutes; RPO is 5 minutes.
